title: Bump @types/node to 26.6.5 across integrations
summary: A dependency-only change: the pinned devDependency @types/node moves from 26.6.2 to 26.6.5 in the dsh, omp and opencode integration packages, and pnpm-lock.yaml is regenerated so every peer-resolution that mentions @types/node (vite, sharp, transformers, pi-coding-agent, protobufjs) now points at the new version. No source, build script or runtime behaviour changes; the blast radius is the workspace's shared type-resolution graph.
